{{Quote|Long before the Empire, travelers fell from the sky. They were monsters, beasts and foul vermin. They created temples dedicated to darkness and evil. Other travelers soon followed. They were noble warriors who carried with them swords of burning light. After a terrible battle, the creatures were finally destroyed and purged from this world. The warriors turned their dark temples into storehouses of knowledge and peace.|The [[Seer of the Temple]]|<ref name="AJ7" />}}
This '''temple''' was located on [[Gap Nine]]. Within the temple were ancient artifacts of great significance to the planet's [[Unidentified Gap Nine species|native]] inhabitants. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the temple was guarded by the [[Seer of the Temple]], who&mdash;with help from a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives&mdash;[[Mission to Gap Nine|defended]] the temple against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raiding party.<ref name="AJ7" />
